home.hero_title: Institutional Credit Audit. Expose 2,000%+ Usurious APR. Defend Borrower Rights.
home.hero_subtitle: Regulatory intelligence against predatory digital lending syndicates. Reconcile net disbursals, calculate true annualized percentage rates (APR) via deterministic mathematics, and compile court-admissible evidence affidavits in seconds.
home.step1_desc: Automated matching against the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) NBFC Master Registry with Fair Practices Code manifest scoring.
home.step2_desc: Isolate hidden deductions, upfront fees, and tenure compressions to calculate true annualized financing cost using pure math.
home.step3_desc: Map harassment to Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS 2023) and compile submission-ready affidavits for police and RBI Ombudsmen.
home.sample_story: Case Audit 8421: Instant ₹5,000 micro-loan sanctioned via social media ad. Net disbursed was only ₹3,500 after illegal underwriting deductions, with ₹5,000 repayment demanded in 7 days (2,235% annualized APR). When overdue, syndicated recovery bots initiated defamatory contact harassment. Sahukar Shield audited the entity, proved regulatory usury, and compiled an admissible cybercrime filing in under 180 seconds.
